metadata.title: World Digest — November 16, 2026
metadata.summary: Markets tumbled as tech shares led a selloff, with Nvidia down 4.12%, while GTA VI's $1 billion preorders signal a massive consumer spending shift.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Apple Faces Unlock: Face ID Coming to iPhone Duo

Apple will let users face-unlock the iPhone Duo, addressing a key drawback of the foldable, via an iOS 27.3 beta update Bloomberg.com. The feature is described as limited Bloomberg.com.

First Fully Automated AI Cyberattack Reported

Google says Russian speakers executed the first-ever fully automated AI cyberattack, with an AI framework turning security patches into working exploits with no human in the loop POLITICO.eu.

Apple Watch Series 12 Hits Record Low Price

Ahead of Black Friday, the Apple Watch Series 12 is available at its cheapest price yet, reaching new record lows The Verge. Deals also include AirPods Pro 3 for $179 IGN.

GTA VI Launch Dominates

With preorders surpassing $1 billion, GTA VI's November 19 launch is expected to trigger a massive nine-day spending shift CNN. A hacker who leaked gameplay footage has pleaded guilty BBC.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Football

49ers 46, Cowboys 40 — Christian McCaffrey’s 74- and 66-yard touchdowns and Deebo Samuel’s 70-yard score powered San Francisco past Dallas in a shootout ESPN.
Bengals 38, Steelers 18 — Joe Burrow led Cincinnati to sole possession of the AFC North lead, beating Pittsburgh ESPN.
Seahawks 21, Raiders 13 — Drew Lock threw two touchdowns and Seattle sacked Fernando Mendoza six times ESPN.

Basketball

Celtics 131, Mavericks 94 — Jayson Tatum scored 32 as Boston set franchise history in a rout ESPN.
Lakers 131, Suns 123 — Luka Doncic poured in 43 as Los Angeles won its eighth straight ESPN.
Spurs 110, Jazz 102 — San Antonio extended its win streak to 12, sending Utah to a 12th straight loss ESPN.

Hockey

Oilers 5, Flyers 2 — Leon Draisaitl scored twice; Connor McDavid tied Wayne Gretzky’s fastest-to-40-assists mark ESPN.

sections.title: Stock Analysis
sections.content:
IPOs

Three listings priced last week: Modern Mining Technology ($4.25, NYSE American) and vVARDIS Holding ($18, NYSE) on Nov 13 Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Upcoming: General Motors (Nasdaq, Nov 17) and Anthropic (Nasdaq, Nov 19), among others Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance.

Major Indices

S&P 500 fell 1.92% to 7,416.59; Nasdaq dropped 2.49%; Dow lost 1.41%; Russell 2000 slid 1.70% Yahoo Finance. VIX surged 18.70% to 22.91 Yahoo Finance.

Sectors

Tech led declines (-3.24%), with Communication Services (-1.72%) and Energy (-1.96%) weak Yahoo Finance. Consumer Staples (+0.27%) and Utilities (+0.18%) were the only gainers Yahoo Finance.

Major Stocks

Nvidia fell 4.12% and was most active Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Alphabet dropped 4.07%, Broadcom 3.92%, Amazon 3.34% Yahoo Finance. Berkshire was flat (-0.02%) Yahoo Finance.

Notable Movers

Top gainers: CG Oncology (+14.0%), Telus (+12.2%), Molina Healthcare (+11.3%) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Losers: Summit Therapeutics (-16.5%), GDS Holdings (-14.7%) Yahoo Finance Yahoo Finance. Intel fell 7.0% on heavy volume Yahoo Finance.

Rates & Commodities

10-year yield slipped 0.64% to 5.12 Yahoo Finance. WTI crude plunged 3.95% to $85.06; gold eased 0.70% to $3,859; bitcoin dipped 0.18% to $65,188 Yahoo Finance.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 Hours

  • GTA VI launch Nov 19: Watch for spending data and digital storefront strain; a $1B preorder base may set sales records.
  • GM IPO Nov 17: First major automaker listing in years; pricing signals EV sector appetite.
  • Apple iOS 27.3 beta: Face ID on iPhone Duo rollout scope may shift foldable demand narrative.

Next Week

  • Anthropic IPO Nov 19: AI valuation test amid Nasdaq weakness (down 2.49%); may set sector tone.
  • Black Friday deals: Record-low Apple Watch pricing could spur hardware rebound after tech-led selloff.

Next Month

  • Fully automated AI cyberattacks may trigger regulatory responses and cybersecurity spending shifts.
  • Volatility likely persists (VIX 22.91); watch 10-year yield near 5.12% for equity pressure.
